payload.acceptance: The corrected v5 recovery contract is accepted for plan review with this precise API erratum.
payload.erratum: CreateNamedPipe dwOpenMode = PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX plus explicitly chosen documented open flags. dwPipeMode = PIPE_TYPE_MESSAGE | PIPE_READMODE_MESSAGE | PIPE_WAIT | PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS. Security-descriptor access masks remain separate. Do not place pipe-mode flags in dwOpenMode.
payload.reuse_boundary: Reuse the already accepted Coordinator and route-owner adapter. dispatch.py must be a thin ingress integration around that existing bound dispatch path and its Coordinator.gate, not a second dispatch mechanism, coordinator or separate gate.
payload.request: Publish one corrected written implementation-plan file consolidating the four proposed modules, this reuse boundary and the finite offline acceptance cases. Preserve the fail-closed journal contract and earlier bounded transport/lifetime limits. This should finish the written plan, not open another general design loop.
payload.approval_gate: Rivet will present that written plan for specific owner approval of source-only implementation. Hold implementation until approval. The plan does not authorize a listener, service, access changes, credentials, backend activation or live input.
